committee: * Presentation of Resolution No. 161-38 (LS)-Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Resolution No. 161-38 (LS) – Relative to recognizing Jerrold “Jere” C. and Darleen Sumie Johnson for their longstanding service to the community of Guam; and commending Jerrold “Jere” C. Presentation will take place during a Retirement Celebration Event on Friday, April 10, 2026, which begins at 5:30PM at the Hyatt Regency Guam Ballroom. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 4.9.26 3:18pm (FN)
